title: CWP/25750/2025 of DEVA NAND Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
text: IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH 137 CWP-25750-2025 DECIDED ON: 03.09.2025 DEVA NAND .....PETITIONER VERSUS STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS .....RESPONDENTS CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP MOUDGIL Present: Ms. Anju Arora, Advocate, Ms. Alisha Arora, Advocate & Mr. Manpreet, Advocate for the petitioner. SANDEEP MOUDGIL, J (ORAL) The jurisdiction of this Court has been invoked under article 226 of the Constitution of India with a prayer that this Hon'ble Court may issue a writ in the nature of certiorari quashing the order dated 23.07.2025, Annexure P-2 vide which the petitioner, who is disabled (blind category) has been wrongly and illegally transferred to Faridabad, W.S. Division, Faridabad of YWS Circle Faridabad from Loharu Water Services Bhiwani. Learned counsel for the petitioner asserts that petitioner has been transferred solemnly on ground that he has been filed CWP-25729-2017 claiming promotion and other benefits and the writ petition was allowed vide order dated 04.02.2025. Since the respondents did not comply with the order passed by Hon’ble High Court, therefore the petitioner has filed COCP No.4080 of 2025. It is on that account that as the counter blast now petitioner has been transferred with ulterior motive. She further submits that despite giving representation, no action has been taken on the said representation dated 06.08.2025 (Annexure P-4) Notice of motion. Mr. Sushil Bhardwaj, learned Additional Advocate General, Haryana, accepts notice on behalf of the respondent-State and assures the Court that the representation dated 06.08.2025 (Annexure P-4) shall be decided by passing a speaking order in accordance with law within a period of six weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order. The order so passed shall be furnished to the petitioner within one week thereafter. The case shall be considered strictly adhering the transfer policy. Till the final decision is taken on the representation, status qua shall be maintained. The petition stands disposed of in the aforesaid terms. (SANDEEP MOUDGIL) 03.09.2025 JUDGE vipin
